name: – Nils Ušakovs – § 63 – Am 66
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2027 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 63. Asks the Commission to provide timely updates on any developments that may affect the overall level of availabilities, including those related to agricultural expenditure, salary update assumptions, NGEU debt servicing and liquidity management costs, financial instrument reflows, decommitments, or any other relevant estimates; demands, furthermore, that the Commission present a separate, detailed report on the full budgetary impact of the Ukraine Support Loan instrument, including annual debt servicing costs borne by the EU budget, the erosion of available headroom resulting from the guarantee, the risk profile of the loan portfolio, a realistic assessment of the likelihood and timeline of repayment given the absence of any enforceable reparations mechanism, and the contingent liabilities falling on the EU budget in the event of a partial or total default;
